claims.statement: Mike McCoole had underrated Tom Allen in the late battle and paid the penalty for it.
claims.excerpt: McCoole had underrated his man, apd paid the penalty

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Mike McCoole were to fight on November 10, 1869.
claims.excerpt: both will step into the ring on the 10th of November,

fights.excerpt: McCoole had underrated his man, apd paid the penalty
fights.notes: The earlier battle is called 'the late battle'; the article gives no date or round details.

fights.excerpt: both will step into the ring on the 10th of November,
